items.title: Rise of Espanyol's English winger Dolan: 'I am not the player I was a year ago'
items.description: Tyrhys Dolan made an explosive start to the season in LaLiga with a goal in Espanyol’s 3-0 win over Levante. The English forward looked particularly sharp. Something has changed. “I am not the person or player I was a year ago,” Dolan tells Sky Sports.
